faq_heading: Broadmoor real estate: your questions answered

blocks.text: Draft for Jared’s approval. Figures are closed sales from Jared’s Paragon export; local facts come from official sources listed at the bottom. It has no listing feed yet.

Broadmoor is an MLS® sub-area of Richmond. Between November 2025 to October 22, 2026, 57 homes sold there: 25 houses, 7 condos and 22 townhomes. 25 houses sold in Broadmoor with a median price of $2,320,000 (the middle half sold between $1,908,000 and $3,000,000), taking a median of 40 days to sell at 91.7% of the last list price; 8% sold above list.
Broadmoor home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

25 houses sold in Broadmoor with a median price of $2,320,000 (the middle half sold between $1,908,000 and $3,000,000), taking a median of 40 days to sell at 91.7% of the last list price; 8% sold above list. They had a median $710 per square foot, a median year built of 2002 and a median lot of 8,115 square feet. 22 townhomes sold in Broadmoor with a median price of $957,500 (the middle half sold between $895,000 and $1,128,250), taking a median of 41 days to sell at 97.1% of the last list price; 9% sold above list. They had a median $629 per square foot, a median year built of 1985 and a median strata fee of $500 a month.

items.t: The City's Broadmoor Area contains three sub-area plans: Ash Street (2.6A), Central West (2.6B) and Sunnymede North (2.6C).
The Central West sub-area plan is bounded by Williams Road (south), No. 3 Road (east), Gilbert Road (west) and the north side of Afton Drive (north).
A City age-friendly report on Broadmoor labels Steveston Highway, Blundell, Francis, Williams, Gilbert, No. 3, No. 4 and Garden City roads on its map but does not state a boundary in text.

The Central West plan designates large-lot single-family (R1/E) in the interior, with townhouse lands on the perimeter under development permit guidelines, and aims to strengthen No. 3 Road as an emerging neighbourhood village.
The plan was adopted in 2001 under Bylaw 7100, so its zone names predate the current Zoning Bylaw 8500.
In 2024 the City moved lots zoned RS1/E into the new RSM/L zone for small-scale multi-unit housing; the minimum lot area for RSM/L is roughly 550 m2.
Sunnymede North applies multi-family development permit guidelines and requires noise assessments.

blocks.text: Broadmoor: parks, community facilities and shopping

items.t: South Arm Community Centre is at 8880 Williams Road beside South Arm Park, which has an outdoor pool, tennis courts and sports fields.
Maple Lane Elementary is at 7671 Alouette Drive.
Hugh McRoberts Secondary is at 8980 Williams Road, on the south edge of the Central West sub-area.

blocks.text: Broadmoor: risks and rules a buyer should know

items.t: Richmond is about 1 m above sea level and relies on 49 km of dikes.
Richmond Fire-Rescue says pockets of liquefaction are possible in a significant earthquake.
Central West policy calls for tree retention or replacement and a 6 m setback from No. 3 Road.

faq.q: What did homes in Broadmoor sell for?
faq.a: 25 houses sold in Broadmoor between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $2,320,000.

faq.q: How long do homes take to sell in Broadmoor?
faq.a: The median was 40 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 91.7% of the last list price (8% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: What price range do most houses in Broadmoor sell in?
faq.a: The middle half of the 25 houses that sold in Broadmoor went for between $1,908,000 and $3,000,000, around a median of $2,320,000.

faq.q: Do houses in Broadmoor sell above asking price?
faq.a: 8% of the 25 houses sold for more than the last list price, and the median sale was 91.7% of it.

faq.q: How old are the houses that sold in Broadmoor?
faq.a: The median year built was 2002 for the 25 houses sold in Broadmoor.

faq.q: How many bedrooms do houses in Broadmoor usually have?
faq.a: The median house that sold in Broadmoor had 5 bedrooms, from the 25 sales between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: Do I need a home inspection when buying in Richmond?
faq.a: It is strongly recommended. Make the offer subject to an inspection so a qualified inspector can look at the roof, structure, drainage, electrical and heating before you remove conditions.
